rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.02 is extremely compressed, making any meaningful risk/reward ratio unachievable — a stop even one ATR away leaves almost no room for profit. Price is consolidating in a tight band near the session low with sharply declining per-candle volume (dropping from 8,735 to under 900 shares), providing no directional signal; the pattern could resolve as a bounce or continuation break with equal probability. With no news catalyst, no sector context, and an already-negative day P&L, there is no identifiable edge to justify capital deployment.
